extracted.name: Beef Heart Stew
extracted.description: This is a very tasty beef heart stew that came from Nova Scotia in the '60s. Beef heart is browned, then cooked with onions to make a tasty stew that goes great over noodles or mashed potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 medium beef heart, rinsed and cubed
instruction_lines: Dredge beef heart in flour until coated.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Fry beef heart in hot oil until browned. Stir in onions and water. Season with salt and seasoned salt. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until meat is very tender, 2 to 3 hours.
Serve over noodles or mashed potatoes.
